name: telegram
description: Bidirectional Telegram messaging for Codex with remote permission control. Send updates and progress to Telegram from Codex; receive messages and commands back as fresh turns in your active thread without keystroke injection.

interface.longDescription: Bidirectional Telegram messaging for Codex. Send progress updates and results to your phone; reply on Telegram to start a new turn or approve/deny tool permissions. Uses Codex's app-server JSON-RPC and PermissionRequest hook — no terminal focus or keystroke injection.
defaultPrompt: Send a status update to my Telegram
